name: zimage_read_texture_directory
description: zImage::ReadTextureDirectory reads serialized texture directory entries, validates the entry count, stores the active count, and converts serialized next-variant indexes back to pointers.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zImage texture-directory/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46d420 validates zero-count return, >0x1000 error, fread into g_zImage_TexDirEntries using 36-byte entries, g_zImage_TexDirEntryCount update, and per-entry nextVariant conversion through zImage::TexIndexToDirEntry.
The native texture-directory write smoke verifies successful read count, global count update, nextVariant index-to-pointer conversion, zero-count behavior, and oversized-count rejection.
